headline: Super Eagles Coach Eric Chelle Announces Squad For Tanzania Matches
seoTitle: Eric Chelle Announces Super Eagles Squad
metaDescription: Nigeria head coach Eric Chelle has selected his 24-man squad for the upcoming AFCON qualifiers, excluding Maduka Okoye and Kelechi Iheanacho.
aiSummaryBullets: Head coach Eric Chelle revealed a 24-man roster for the upcoming 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying matches.
The squad selection notably omits goalkeeper Maduka Okoye and forward Kelechi Iheanacho.
Key players including Wilfred Ndidi and Alex Iwobi have been included in the upcoming double-header against Tanzania.
aiContextParagraph: The Super Eagles are preparing for an upcoming double-header against Tanzania as part of the qualification process for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations. The team is currently under the leadership of head coach Eric Chelle, who has been tasked with assembling the roster for these critical fixtures. The squad announcement has drawn attention due to the absence of notable figures such as Maduka Okoye and Kelechi Iheanacho, despite recent performances. The inclusion of experienced players like Wilfred Ndidi and Alex Iwobi suggests a tactical focus for the upcoming games. These matches serve as a pivotal step in Nigeria's campaign to qualify for the continental tournament, with the selection process reflecting the coach's current strategic direction for the national team's roster as they look to secure a position in the final competition held in 2027.
whyItIsViral: The selection news has garnered attention across two major sports outlets, reflecting significant interest in the national team's personnel decisions.
